info.description: A heading, optionally carrying a link and optionally listed in the table of contents.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Level
edit.description: How large the heading looks. It does not decide the heading's rank in the document — that follows from how deeply the heading is nested.

edit.label: Show in the table of contents?
edit.description: Lists this heading in the table of contents, where the page has one.

list.label: Show in the table of contents?

edit.label: Link
edit.description: An optional link shown beside the heading.

edit.label: Text colour
edit.description: The colour of the words. "auto" is no answer at all and leaves it to the block, which draws a heading in the page’s own colour. "context" names that colour outright, and follows both the event the page belongs to and the colour scheme its editor chose; "theme" is that event’s theme colour whatever the page is set to. A link beside the heading carries its own.
